subject: Data
title: Data and Climate: The Environmental Cost of Information
description: Learn Data and Climate: The Environmental Cost of Information in one minute.

hook.text: Data centers now consume more electricity than many countries. Training one large AI model can emit tons of carbon.

buildup.text: The data industry's energy consumption is growing at 20-30% annually, driven by AI training and cloud computing.

discovery.text: Global data centers produce roughly 2% of world CO₂ emissions — comparable to the airline industry.

twist.text: Tech companies claim carbon neutrality while building massive new data centers.

climax.text: The hidden environmental cost of data is becoming a major sustainability challenge as AI usage explodes.

punchline.text: Every query has a carbon footprint. The cloud isn't weightless.

quiz.question: How much of global CO₂ emissions do data centers produce?
